a solid state battery design would be a key to unlock the full potential of organic cathode materials.
the solid state design would be a viable strategy to realize high capacity, high cycleability organic batteries.

the solid state design strategy could be applied to many organic cathodes that were not suitable for conventional liquid electrolyte systems.
